name: Build Log Exists and is Non-Empty
description: Verify that the file 'build.log' exists in the current directory and contains at least one line of output.

name: No Build Errors in Log
description: Ensure the build log does not contain the string 'error' (case-insensitive), indicating a successful build without compilation errors.

name: Build Completion Message Present
description: Verify that the build log contains a success indicator such as 'Build succeeded' or 'Finished' to confirm the build process completed.

name: No Warnings in Log
description: Ensure the build log does not contain the string 'warning' (case-insensitive), indicating a clean build without warnings.
